tool_args.rationale: The five observations are insufficient to distinguish the candidate smooth response families or determine whether a second conjunctive branch contributes. An open-branch discriminating observation directly tests that ambiguity at lower cost than a broad trajectory batch.

considered_alternatives.option: author_and_confirm_python_model: fit a stationary smooth response from the five rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All rows share the same past input, state, memory, and horizon; changing u_now and s_grad together leaves their contributions confounded, so a fitted law would not be identifiable.
A broad trajectory batch costs more and is unnecessary before testing the unresolved branch structure.
No such probe appears in the available cost menu, and observed s_grad values do not cross the cited threshold.
It is explicitly nuisance data and would not resolve the structural ambiguity.
